issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 04 asks for the number of swimming pools in municipalities with more than 1000 female inhabitants, but the solution query uses a threshold of 2000 (Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 2000). This contradicts the specification and will cause student submissions to be judged against a different criterion than described.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the threshold consistent: either update the solution query to use AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000 to match the problem statement, or revise the problem statement to request municipalities with more than 2000 female inhabitants. Preferably change the solution to use > 1000 so it matches the stated task.
